mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT subject_id FROM crm_activity WHERE subject_type = 'Contact' AND subject_id IS NOT NULL

SELECT a.subject_id AS contact_id,
COUNT(*) AS total_event_count, MAX(a.started_date) AS last_event_at,
MIN(a.started_date) FILTER (WHERE a.event_type = 'channel.wecom.added') AS wecom_added_at, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE a.event_type LIKE 'channel.wecom.message.%') AS wecom_message_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE a.event_type = 'channel.wecom.message.sent') AS wecom_outbound_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE a.event_type = 'channel.wecom.message.received') AS wecom_inbound_count, MAX(a.started_date) FILTER (WHERE a.event_type LIKE 'channel.wecom.message.%') AS wecom_last_message_at, (COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE a.event_type = 'channel.wecom.group.joined') - COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE a.event_type = 'channel.wecom.group.quit')) AS wecom_group_count, COUNT(DISTINCT DATE(a.started_date)) FILTER (WHERE a.channel = 'wecom' AND a.started_date >= now() - INTERVAL '30 days') AS wecom_active_days_30d,
MIN(a.started_date) FILTER (WHERE a.event_type = 'channel.wechat_mp.follow') AS wechat_mp_followed_at, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE a.event_type = 'channel.wechat_mp.article.read' AND a.started_date >= now() - INTERVAL '30 days') AS wechat_mp_article_read_30d,
COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE a.event_type = 'channel.wechat_miniapp.login' AND a.started_date >= now() - INTERVAL '30 days') AS wechat_miniapp_login_30d, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE a.event_type = 'channel.wechat_miniapp.form.submit') AS wechat_miniapp_form_submit,
COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE a.event_type LIKE 'lead.%' AND a.event_type NOT IN ('lead.converted')) AS lead_count, MIN(a.started_date) FILTER (WHERE a.event_type = 'lead.created') AS lead_created_at, (COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE a.event_type = 'lead.converted') > 0) AS has_lead_converted,
COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE a.event_type = 'appointment.created') AS appointment_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE a.event_type = 'appointment.noshow') AS appointment_noshow_count,
COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE a.event_type IN ('visit.first', 'visit.return')) AS visit_count, MIN(a.started_date) FILTER (WHERE a.event_type IN ('visit.first', 'visit.return')) AS first_visit_at, MAX(a.started_date) FILTER (WHERE a.event_type IN ('visit.first', 'visit.return')) AS last_visit_at,
COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE a.event_type = 'opportunity.created') AS opportunity_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE a.event_type = 'opportunity.won') AS opportunity_won_count,
COALESCE(SUM((a.payload->>'amount')::numeric) FILTER (WHERE a.event_type = 'opportunity.won'), 0) AS total_revenue, AVG((a.payload->>'amount')::numeric) FILTER (WHERE a.event_type = 'opportunity.won') AS avg_deal_amount, MAX(a.started_date) FILTER (WHERE a.event_type = 'opportunity.won') AS last_payment_at,
(SELECT (payload->>'score')::int FROM crm_activity a2 WHERE a2.subject_id = a.subject_id AND a2.event_type = 'ai.scored' AND a2.payload->>'score' IS NOT NULL ORDER BY a2.started_date DESC LIMIT 1) AS ai_score_latest,
(SELECT a2.started_date FROM crm_activity a2 WHERE a2.subject_id = a.subject_id AND a2.event_type = 'ai.scored' ORDER BY a2.started_date DESC LIMIT 1) AS ai_score_updated_at,
COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE a.event_type IN ('ai.tag_predicted', 'ai.tagged')) AS ai_tag_count,
(SELECT a2.payload->>'intent' FROM crm_activity a2 WHERE a2.subject_id = a.subject_id AND a2.event_type = 'ai.intent_detected' AND a2.payload->>'intent' IS NOT NULL ORDER BY a2.started_date DESC LIMIT 1) AS ai_intent_latest
FROM crm_activity a WHERE a.subject_type = 'Contact' AND a.subject_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY a.subject_id
